reading_issues: Same pit supplied as JPG and PDF (identical content), one JSON lists both. Bar steps and boundaries measured from pixels in both renders (0, 20, 45, 75, 90, 115, 135 cm). Glyph for 0-45 cm (small square with an arched top and horizontal bar) read as FCxr (square-based). CTN arrow points at the 0 cm line, so test height recorded 0 with a comment; the result is 'no result/no fracture'. Temperatures read by pixel centroid on the -10..0 C axis (20 cm intervals; no point below 20 cm or at the surface). Red line at 90 cm marks the base of the flagged 90-115 cm layer. Surface grain not in header; top layer is DF with PP secondary so header surface_grain left null.
